releaseNotes: Export Clash Detective summary report to Excel.
Export Clash Detective summary report to PDF.
Supports with-stage and without-stage report templates.
PDF output fits all report columns to page width.
Built-in GitHub update checker and downloader.
Editable Word and Excel templates are copied to the user's Documents folder.
Installer EXE includes the DLL, cover template, both Excel templates, and PDF merge library.
Adds automatic trade-only summary export for clash names such as 0001_PA_FPR_vs_IRR.
Fixes Navisworks Manage 2027 loading by building against the 2027 API.
Adds Fast Export Mode for detailed clash reports to skip screenshots, item paths, and grid lookup on large models.
Installer and online updater now select the correct DLL for each Navisworks API version.
Legacy installer supports Navisworks Manage 2020 through 2026; 2027 uses a separate API-specific installer.
Fixes reading Clash Detective tests in Navisworks Manage 2027 using TestsRoot.Children.
Simplifies detailed report options: Fast Export Mode controls whether clash images are included.
Online update downloads version-specific zip files for 2020-2026 and 2027.
